Sikes, K., Ford, J., Blackburn, J. (SRA International) and McGill, R. (Fuels, Engines and Emissions Consulting) (2015). Feasibility of Natural Gas Pathways for Motor Vehicles: An International Comparison. IEA Advanced Motor Fuels Implementing Agreement, Annex 48, August 2015.

BACKGROUND ONLY - no extraction. What it is and why no data: Road-vehicle fuel-pathway study (CNG, LNG, GTL, methanol, DME, hydrogen, electricity from natural gas) by GHGenius lifecycle and cost modelling for six countries. Road vehicles are excluded (Brad 2026-10-03). The cover page has no text layer; title and authors read from the rendered page. What it does have: Lifecycle GHG and lifecycle cost per km by country and pathway; vehicle fuel economy and incremental cost assumptions; natural gas to gasoline pathway added to GHGenius (appendix). No production-plant capex or efficiency printed in tables.
